description: This file declares helper routines for USB device interactions in an Android-related Windows environment, including device enumeration, interface details, and communication parameters.

methods.name: GetSDKComplientParam
methods.description: Converts internal access type and sharing mode enums into SDK-specific flags.

methods.name: EnumerateDeviceInterfaces
methods.description: Enumerates device interfaces matching specific criteria.

methods.name: GetUsbDeviceDetails
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific USB device interface.

methods.name: GetUsbDeviceName
methods.description: Obtains the device name based on device information data.

methods.name: IsLegacyInterface
methods.description: Checks if a given interface is supported via a custom USB driver or WinUsb.
